Do free alternative-data signals predict results and returns?

Generated 2026-11-10. Sources: Amazon Reviews 2023 (McAuley Lab), Wikimedia pageviews, SEC EDGAR, Yahoo Finance. Research only, not investment advice.

Verdict (all companies pooled)

  • Tone vs sales surprise: no link (could easily be luck). Correlation +0.02, 1182 company-quarters, luck p=0.480, q=0.585.
  • Tone vs next sales surprise: a very weak link in the OPPOSITE direction (borderline). Correlation -0.05, 1190 company-quarters, luck p=0.076, q=0.200.
  • Tone vs earnings-day move: no link (could easily be luck). Correlation -0.01, 1074 company-quarters, luck p=0.796, q=0.857.
  • Tone vs next-quarter return: a very weak link in the predicted direction (borderline). Correlation +0.05, 1077 company-quarters, luck p=0.078, q=0.200.
  • Stars vs sales surprise: no link (could easily be luck). Correlation +0.03, 1182 company-quarters, luck p=0.278, q=0.398.
  • Stars vs next sales surprise: no link (could easily be luck). Correlation -0.04, 1190 company-quarters, luck p=0.226, q=0.393.
  • Stars vs earnings-day move: no link (could easily be luck). Correlation -0.01, 1074 company-quarters, luck p=0.687, q=0.770.
  • Stars vs next-quarter return: a very weak link in the predicted direction (holds up after allowing for the number of tests). Correlation +0.09, 1077 company-quarters, luck p=0.003, q=0.020.
  • Wikipedia vs sales surprise: no link (borderline). Correlation +0.05, 1382 company-quarters, luck p=0.061, q=0.190.
  • Wikipedia vs next sales surprise: no link (could easily be luck). Correlation +0.03, 1349 company-quarters, luck p=0.253, q=0.393.
  • Wikipedia vs earnings-day move: no link (could easily be luck). Correlation -0.00, 1275 company-quarters, luck p=0.922, q=0.922.
  • Wikipedia vs next-quarter return: no link (could easily be luck). Correlation +0.04, 1255 company-quarters, luck p=0.252, q=0.393.
  • Google search vs sales surprise: a weak link in the predicted direction (holds up after allowing for the number of tests). Correlation +0.20, 1605 company-quarters, luck p=0.000, q=0.005.
  • Google search vs next sales surprise: a weak link in the predicted direction (holds up after allowing for the number of tests). Correlation +0.14, 1573 company-quarters, luck p=0.000, q=0.005.
  • Google search vs earnings-day move: no link (could be luck, given how many tests were run). Correlation +0.05, 1486 company-quarters, luck p=0.048, q=0.170.
  • Google search vs next-quarter return: a very weak link in the predicted direction (holds up after allowing for the number of tests). Correlation +0.10, 1466 company-quarters, luck p=0.000, q=0.005.
  • Filing words vs sales surprise: no link (borderline). Correlation +0.03, 1656 company-quarters, luck p=0.151, q=0.325.
  • Filing words vs next sales surprise: no link (could easily be luck). Correlation +0.02, 1617 company-quarters, luck p=0.284, q=0.398.
  • Filing words vs earnings-day move: no link (could easily be luck). Correlation -0.00, 1537 company-quarters, luck p=0.920, q=0.922.
  • Filing words vs next-quarter return: a very weak link in the OPPOSITE direction (holds up after allowing for the number of tests). Correlation -0.06, 1520 company-quarters, luck p=0.005, q=0.026.
  • Insider buying vs sales surprise: no link (could easily be luck). Correlation -0.02, 1095 company-quarters, luck p=0.557, q=0.650.
  • Insider buying vs next sales surprise: no link (could easily be luck). Correlation +0.03, 1072 company-quarters, luck p=0.387, q=0.492.
  • Insider buying vs earnings-day move: a very weak link in the predicted direction (borderline). Correlation +0.05, 1018 company-quarters, luck p=0.096, q=0.225.
  • Insider buying vs next-quarter return: no link (could easily be luck). Correlation +0.03, 1007 company-quarters, luck p=0.322, q=0.429.
  • Short interest vs sales surprise: no link (borderline). Correlation +0.04, 1365 company-quarters, luck p=0.194, q=0.388.
  • Short interest vs next sales surprise: a very weak link in the predicted direction (could be luck, given how many tests were run). Correlation +0.06, 1325 company-quarters, luck p=0.033, q=0.134.
  • Short interest vs earnings-day move: no link (could easily be luck). Correlation +0.04, 1272 company-quarters, luck p=0.213, q=0.393.
  • Short interest vs next-quarter return: a very weak link in the predicted direction (holds up after allowing for the number of tests). Correlation +0.09, 1257 company-quarters, luck p=0.001, q=0.007.

Correlations are "aligned": positive means the signal moved in the direction the idea predicts (for example better tone, more insider buying or less short selling before better outcomes). "Luck p-value" comes from shuffling quarters within each company 2,000 times; "q" adjusts it for the number of tests run, and below 0.05 counts as a finding. Each company's own average is removed first. Sales surprise = revenue growth vs a year earlier, minus what last quarter's growth predicted. Earnings-day move = the stock vs SPY around the results announcement. Review data stops in 2023; the other signals run to the latest quarter.

Do the pooled results hold up?

Each pooled result below p=0.05 is re-run on half the companies, on earlier and later years, and with each company left out. A real effect should show up, with the same sign, in every split.
